risk_points: Grid build-out and transmission interconnection remain major delivery bottlenecks.
Permitting and project pipeline conversion still slow down announced capacity ambitions.
Supply-chain and financing conditions can compress delivery schedules even when demand remains strong.
action_implications: Track near-term grid and interconnection execution alongside generation additions.
Separate momentum in solar and wind build rates from overall power-system integration readiness.
Use country comparisons to distinguish scale stories from share-of-mix stories.
speaker_note_hint: Keep the story executive-facing: 1 headline, 1 chart, 2-4 lines of evidence per slide.
